thread:
keisha: Heads-up — NebulaHealth flagged a $18,920 surprise overage on their May dedicated invoice. They claim a region failover during our maintenance caused a spike. Can finance + SRE review? @ajay @li @maria

ajay: Please attach the invoice excerpt and the exact usage window. I'll pull meter lines.

keisha: Excerpt from their upload:
```
Invoice: INV-2026-0519
Reserved commit: $12,000
Burst/overage: $18,920
Period: 2026-05-01 1 2026-05-31
Flag: Region failover 2026-05-12 22:30-01:00 UTC
```

li: Verified via ops-bot: INCIDENT-2026-401 triggered at 2026-05-12T22:27Z, maintenance in ap-southeast caused failover to us-west, affected dedicated pools: nebula-prod-{a,b}. Autoscale and rehydration produced additional GPU-hours.

ops-bot: INCIDENT-2026-401: planned-maintenance -> region-failover-ap -> us-west. start: 2026-05-12T22:27Z end: 2026-05-13T01:05Z. Impact: increased GPU hours + egress.

maria: Contract notes: (A) We bill bursts by usage; (B) For planned maintenance we provide notice and follow runbook; if we did, credits are discretionary. Need legal review but we have history with similar cases.

ajay: Metering quick snapshot: total burst compute charge $13,400; cross-region egress $2,100; misc infra (storage rehydration) $1,420 = $16,920 (small rounding diff vs their $18,920). I suspect some tagging mismatch. I'll reconcile tagging and create a proforma credit calc.

keisha: Customer is upset — they lost a demo slot. Asking for full waiver. Want to respond within 6 hours.

sam: For customers impacted during planned maintenance we usually offer partial goodwill, especially if runbook was followed. Propose: waive all cross-region egress charges + 50% of compute burst. Also offer one-month gratis retention for Dedicated Insights.

maria: Sounds reasonable. Estimate: waive egress $2,100 + compute credit ~6,700 = total ~$8,800. Add retention value note $0 (promotional). Get signoff from finance.

ajay: I can issue a credit memo: "Goodwill credit for maintenance-triggered failover: compute credit $6,700; egress waived $2,100; total credit $8,800." Will post as CM-2026-1142.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-1142 created, pending approval.

keisha: I will send a sympathetic note: acknowledge impact, confirm we followed maintenance notice, offer the credit and next steps. Also promise postmortem and steps we will take to reduce future risk.

li: I'll publish a short postmortem in eng-sre with timeline and remediation (improve pre-warm for failovers, adjust autoscale caps). Will tag customer-safe summary.

maria: Legal: quick thumbs up on goodwill credit. Confirming no precedence conflict.

sam: Approving CM-2026-1142. Please mark as "Goodwill - maintenance linked" and apply to INV-2026-0519.

ajay: Applied credit CM-2026-1142 to INV-2026-0519. Updated invoice pushed to billing portal. Journal entry posted (JE-2026-991).

keisha: NebulaHealth acknowledged receipt and appreciated the quick handling. They asked for a short customer-facing root-cause that avoids internal details. I'll draft and include the credit.

ops-bot: ACTIONS: 1) Apply credit - ajay. 2) Customer comms - keisha. 3) SRE postmortem - li. 4) Legal confirmation - maria.

keisha: Closing loop once the customer confirms final PDF. Thanks all. :heart:
